decisions.reason: Turnaround management is the flagship of the firm's announced airport digitalization direction and has its own dedicated page, so its visible commitment and the investment already sunk make continuation very likely.
As a connectivity module that links apron equipment to the turnaround platform, it is integral to the announced suite, and its early weak visibility can be blamed on a young market.
Revenue calculation and billing builds on the same apron data and supports the platform story, so management will keep it while attributing slow uptake to long airport procurement cycles.
Equipment monitoring fits the firm's electrical equipment core and its digital service ambitions, which justifies the investment already made and favors keeping it.
Resource management is a module of the committed apron software suite, and dropping it so soon would undercut the strategy the firm has announced.

The safety alert service is somewhat less central to the apron platform and is only mentioned on the website, but the firm's recent public launch and the costs already incurred still make keeping it more likely than dropping it.
